item.description:
ThorReborn now updates itself.

  • Check for Updates works, from the menu bar or Settings, signed with Sparkle.
  • New "Automatically check for updates" setting.
  • Releases are now signed with a stable certificate, so updates keep your Accessibility permission.
  • App icons for symlinked apps (like Safari) no longer show an alias arrow.

Coming from 1.0.0? That version can't update itself, so download this one by hand, quit ThorReborn, and replace the app in Applications. Future updates install from inside the app.
